description: supervisor silently dropped for every Daily Report V3 crew row + every field picker consuming the canonical HR roster
affected_consumers: Daily Report V3 · EmployeeCombo · trench EmployeePicker · every field form
root_cause: Projection listed supervisor_name/supervisor_id (dead alias keys HR never writes) instead of the canonical write key `supervisor`
fix_applied: server.py roster projection replaced with lib/employee_identity.PUBLIC_ROSTER_PROJECTION which includes supervisor + normalizer emits supervisor_display

description: division projected on /api/employees but never populated in write schema (HR writes department not division)

fix_applied: removed from projection · pickHrFields still keeps division as a defensive alias in case old cached responses carry it

description: /api/employees and /api/hr/employee-roster returned different HR field shapes for the same underlying document
affected_consumers: every field picker on the platform
root_cause: Two separate projection specs maintained in server.py · no shared normalizer
fix_applied: Both endpoints now use the shared lib/employee_identity.PUBLIC_ROSTER_PROJECTION + normalize_employee_identity → identical field contract emitted from both

description: ODS labor_fact / PDF / email required consumers to re-derive HR aliases (trade OR role OR trade_snapshot ...) — every consumer implemented the fallback logic slightly differently

fix_applied: V3 crew row now snapshots trade_role_display / crew_display / supervisor_display at submit · ODS labor_fact adds those keys to payload · PDF prefers *_display keys
